id./param/scenario/cs/b_030_cs_030.pack|cs_: "Beyond this door lies the Field of Discipline of Angri-La.
"Before we see it, let me tell you the temple's tale of the Luminary of Legend, Erdwin.
"In the Age of Heroes, on his journey to defeat the Dark One, Erdwin visited Angri-La, a mystical temple of sages.
"He became a disciple of Ai Yi, our first Grand Master, a man of deep wisdom, and sharpened his power in this field.
"And as his training continued, Erdwin had a fateful meeting with a certain person.
"Another disciple under the Grand Master, the finest of them all, a great mage... Morcant.
"They trained together, each acknowledging the other's strength, and became friends.
"After training, Morcant joined Erdwin's party and is said to have been of great help against the Dark One.
"That stone is inscribed with words in which they pledged their friendship and resolved to defeat the Dark One.
"Erdwin and Morcant... A very interesting legend.
"Enough old tales. Let me show you the Field of Discipline. Please follow me."
